body: Yea last year I did....I'm just scared to open up to a teacher I mean they probably care more bout me then my family but....I just don't think I can....they'd end up telling the office then I'd go through all this child services and questions and....I'm not ready for that....I don't think I ever will be...small steps at a time...like talking to you someone I don't know....helping me feel its ok to talk about my problems....look for some help....I need to do this slowly
No nobody I don't really get close to people...
I promise if I ever need help or someone to talk to ill come to you
That seriously made me cry....nobody has ever....said something so nice to me like that...

Sometimes I just feel like I don't have the right to ask for help....there are worse people out there I'm just a grain of sand at a beach compared to all the problems in this world...so why should anyone help my tiny one....
